options.name: image_name
options.description: Name of the partition image. The value must follow original F5 ISO naming pattern: C(F5OS-C-) if C(iso_version) is not provided.

options.name: iso_version
options.description: The F5OS-C OS version. When not provided, the value is extracted from the provided C(image_name).

options.name: protocol
options.description: Protocol to be used for image transfer. The parameter is required when other than default when C(state) is C(present).

options.name: remote_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the remote server on which the partition image is stored. The server must make the image accessible via the specified C(protocol). The parameter is required when C(state) is C(import) or C(state) is C(present).

options.name: remote_password
options.description: Password for the user on the remote server on which the partition image is stored.

options.name: remote_path
options.description: The path to the partition image on the remote server. The parameter is required when C(state) is C(import) or C(state) is C(present).

options.name: remote_port
options.description: The port to connect to on the remote host. If the port is not provided, a default port for the selected C(protocol) is used.

options.name: remote_user
options.description: User name for the remote server on which the partition image is stored.

options.name: state
options.description: The partition image state. If C(import), starts the image import task if the image does not exist. If C(present), checks for the status of the import task if the image does not exist. If C(absent), deletes the partition image if it exists.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The number of seconds to wait for image import to finish. The accepted value range is between C(150) and C(3600) seconds.
